parts.what: the one isometric board of the whole film, built with ctx.engine (held across continue joins, rebuilt identically after a cut at any framing and state): one road back-left to front-right joining, in narration order, the company office (accent2, with the colleague's desk and screen and an order plate in front), the warehouse (concrete hall, two shelf rows, a packing bench with a conveyor, cut-away-able), the hub (large hall facade, a sorter belt with a scanner arch and three outbound lanes inside, three dock doors with trucks, a departure screen with rows), the local depot (small hall, two teal vans) and the customer's street (three houses, trees). It returns handles for every station, item, anchor and route point so beats only add to it, plus a night state (a cool dark wash with lit windows) and a grey state (focus with nothing in colour).

the subject, the only vermilion thing on the board: states order card (a small flat card lying on the board), lamp (an unboxed lamp on a shelf deck), box (the labelled lamp box, a crate with a white label decal); a you-are-here ring and a 'Lamp' pin; travels along the board's routes

the customer's phone as a flat white card beside the board, every word real: state page (a lamp thumbnail, an Order button, 'Arrives tomorrow'), state trail (status lines added one at a time with a dot each: Confirmed, Dispatched, At hub, Out for delivery, Delivered; it can stop after any line and show an empty gap with a '?'), state reply (her thread with the colleague's answer)

the colleague's message thread as a flat white card by the office desk: an incoming bubble 'Where is my order?', then a reply that builds line by line (up to four short lines, each with a small step chip)

the held-spot marker: a neg ring laid on the board at a spot where something waits, with a small pause glyph and an optional 1 to 3 word pin; never on a person; several can show at once, each with its own time

devices.what: the subject in the reserved vermilion: the lamp's order card, then from packing the labelled lamp box with a you-are-here ring
a delay drawn as a thing held at a station, marked by held_mark
the five station pins on the board, reused where scans pop and where to look
the phone card: order page, tracking trail, reply
the colleague's thread: question, reply in steps

one board; beats continue on it and the in-board camera glides station to station; hard cuts only where place, time or register change (inside the warehouse, night at the hub, the grey tracking map, back at the desk)

colour withheld for the scans and the quiz
